items.title: Template Expressions
items.content_text: Blogin's layouts are HAML. What HAML does not define is the language inside = ..., - if ..., and #{...}. Ruby HAML embeds Ruby. Blogin embeds a small language of its own.

items.title: HAML Compatibility
items.content_text: There is no HAML standard. Ruby HAML is a reference implementation that embeds Ruby, and every implementation embeds some host language. The structural syntax is what carries across, and the…

items.title: Data File YAML
items.content_text: Blogin reads YAML in two places: data/*.yaml, which a layout reads through data, and _data.yaml beside a section, which a layout reads the same way for pages in that section. See Data files for how…
